title: Establish per-stakeholder signoff lanes and ambiguity-resolution cadence for PRD v2 scope trimming
creator: Asha Raman
description: Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable signoff and ambiguity-resolution process for PRD v2 scope trimming so we can close scope decisions within a bounded SLA and avoid blockages across Eng/Design/Legal.

Why: The PRD for the runtime-telemetry changes is large and contains ~18 open scope questions across privacy, migration, and UI surface. Historically these questions have stalled releases for weeks. We need a small operational playbook (per-stakeholder lanes + 48h decision windows + decision log) that PMs can run to complete signoffs for incremental PRD slices.

Deliverables: (1) 'Signoff lanes' definition document (Confluence) listing who must sign (owner, eng lead, design lead, legal counsel, security), expected response SLA, and fallback policy. (2) Ambiguity-resolution cadence template (weekly 30-min decision sync + ad-hoc 48h async channel). (3) Decision log template and example entries. (4) A short acceptance checklist to attach to PRDs for gating release readiness.

Scope: This ticket covers process and templates only, plus initial run for PRD v2 scope trimming. Does NOT include changing product code or implementing telemetry changes (those are separate ENG tickets).
Out-of-scope: Building new tooling or automations; we will use Confluence + existing Slack/Drafts + GitHub PR comments for the first iteration.
Stakeholders: PM (Asha Raman), Eng owners (Diego Morales, Maya Patel), Design owner (Sofia Chen), Legal (Hernan Ruiz), Security (Leah Brooks), and Release manager (Oliver Grant).
updates: 2026-03-03: Kickoff sync with Eng/Design/Legal. Agreed to 48h async response SLA after a question is posted to #prd-v2-decision. Action: Diego to draft signoff lanes doc by 2026-03-05.
2026-03-05: Diego uploaded initial lanes doc (Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood.com/prd-v2/signoff-lanes). Requested legal to annotate data-residency items as high-priority.

2026-03-08: Legal (Hernan) clarified that telemetry schema changes will require a separate data flow diagram and will add 3 business days for full counsel review if PI surfaces. Action: PM to add 'data-flow diagram required' checkbox to acceptance checklist.
2026-03-10: Design review (Sofia) suggested trimming UI variant C as out-of-scope to reduce review surface — PM accepted for initial rollout. Action: DES-4821 to update mockups and attach to PRD.

2026-03-11: Decision: split PRD v2 into 'core' and 'deferred' slices. Core slice will be the target for this signoff process. Action owners assigned: Core scope owner = Diego, legal signoff owner = Hernan, design signoff owner = Sofia.

2026-03-14: Pilot run: posted 7 ambiguous questions to #prd-v2-decision. 5 resolved within 48h; 2 escalated to weekly decision sync and resolved during meeting. Next step: finalize checklist and roll to other PMs as a template.

Artifacts: PRD link https://drive.redwood.com/drive/prd-v2-scope-trim, Decision log template https://confluence.redwood.com/templates/decision-log, Example GH PR for signoff checklist https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3344
acceptance_criteria: Signed signoff lanes doc published in Confluence with named owners and response SLAs.
Ambiguity-resolution cadence template (meeting agenda + async channel practice) published and tested in one pilot run.
Decision log template created and populated with >= 5 real entries from the PRD v2 pilot.
Acceptance checklist attached to PRD v2 'core' slice and verified by Eng, Design, and Legal (explicit comment or GH approval).
Post-pilot retro documented with at least 3 improvement actions and owners assigned.
